description: This file defines the class 'Crypt_Blowfish_DefaultKey' which contains default key data for the Blowfish encryption algorithm implementation. It initializes the default P-array and S-boxes used in Blowfish cipher with predefined hexadecimal values.

classes.name: Crypt_Blowfish_DefaultKey
classes.description: A class holding default key material (P-array and S-boxes) for Blowfish encryption algorithm.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializes the P-array and S-boxes with predefined hexadecimal values for Blowfish cipher.
